bearerAuth.description: Bearer access token from `POST /api/v1/token` (or the static `METRICS_TOKEN` for `GET /metrics`). System-admin session cookies are also accepted for management endpoints.

info.description: HTTP API for issuing tokens, sending mail, and managing SMTP configs, jobs, and tokens. All responses use the `{ ok }` envelope; errors additionally carry `error` (and `issues` for validation).
info.title: Relanto Mailer API

get.description: Lists applications visible to the caller. Requires the `manageApplications` scope.

post.description: Creates a new application under an application admin. Requires the `manageApplications` scope.

get.description: Returns the application-facing SMTP config (without username). Requires the `readConfig` scope.

403.description: Only application tokens may read the application config.

get.description: Lists SMTP configs visible to the caller. Requires the `manageApplications` scope.

post.description: Creates a new SMTP config for an application. Requires the `manageApplications` scope.

403.description: Application tokens cannot create SMTP configs.

409.description: SMTP config application cannot be changed.

get.description: Returns a single SMTP config view (admin-side, with username). Requires the `manageApplications` scope.

put.description: Replaces an SMTP config with a full representation. Requires the `manageApplications` scope.

409.description: SMTP config application cannot be changed.

get.description: Lists the tokens issued for an SMTP config. Requires the `manageTokens` scope.

post.description: Issues a new application or application-admin token for an SMTP config. Requires the `manageTokens` scope.

409.description: Application requires an SMTP config before tokens can be issued.

post.summary: Create a token for a config

post.description: Verifies connectivity of an SMTP config and returns the result. Requires the `validate` scope.

get.description: Lists mail job status views scoped to the caller. Requires the `readStatus` scope.

parameters.description: Restrict by application (ignored for application tokens).
parameters.name: applicationId

parameters.description: Only jobs created strictly after this ISO 8601 instant.
parameters.name: createdAfter

parameters.description: Only jobs created strictly before this ISO 8601 instant.
parameters.name: createdBefore

parameters.description: Exact match on the mail Message-ID.
parameters.name: messageId

200.description: List of mail job status views.

post.description: Returns delivery-status polling results for a bounded list of known job IDs. Unknown, deleted or retention-purged IDs are returned as per-job 'unknown' results. Requires the `readStatus` scope.

200.description: Per-job delivery-status polling results in request order.

413.description: Request body exceeds the maximum allowed size.

delete.description: Deletes an owned mail job that is neither processing nor sent. Requires the `manageApplications` scope.

409.description: Processing or sent jobs cannot be deleted.

get.description: Returns the status view of a single owned mail job. Requires the `readStatus` scope.
Returns the client-facing delivery status for a single job ID. Unknown, deleted or retention-purged IDs are returned as an 'unknown' result. Requires the `readStatus` scope.

post.description: Pauses a pending mail job. Requires the `manageApplications` scope.

409.description: Only pending jobs can be paused.

post.description: Resumes a paused mail job. Requires the `manageApplications` scope.

409.description: Only paused jobs can be resumed.

post.description: Manually retries a failed or uncertain mail job. Requires the `manageApplications` scope.

409.description: Only failed or uncertain jobs can be retried manually.

post.description: Enqueues a mail job (or sends it directly). Only application tokens may send. Requires the `send` scope.

403.description: System-admin session or application-admin token cannot send mail.

404.description: SMTP config or application not found.

409.description: Direct send did not end in 'sent'.

post.description: Exchanges client credentials for a short-lived bearer access token.

413.description: Request body exceeds the maximum allowed size.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a token. Requires the `manageTokens` scope.

get.description: Returns a single token's metadata. Requires the `manageTokens` scope.

post.description: Revokes a token so it can no longer be exchanged for access tokens. Requires the `manageTokens` scope.
Rotates a token's secret and returns the new clientSecret. Requires the `manageTokens` scope.

patch.description: Replaces the scope set of a token. Requires the `manageTokens` scope.

get.description: Reports database and worker health. No authentication required.
Returns operational metrics. Requires the static METRICS_TOKEN as a bearer token.
